title: AI reads notes end to end
description: A real MCP client over in-memory transport lists tools/resources/prompts, then list_notes (each view), search_notes, get_note, weekly_summary, reads quicknotes://today and gets weekly-review against a fake Firestore holding own, shared, done, moved and trashed notes.
criterion: A real MCP client over in-memory transport lists tools/resources/prompts, then list_notes (each view), search_notes, get_note, weekly_summary, reads quicknotes://today and gets weekly-review against a fake Firestore holding own, shared, done, moved and trashed notes; results match expectations and trashed notes never appear by default.
prerequisites: Go 1.27+, Node 20+ (for the web-side checks). No network, no real account: a local fake Firebase is used.
